admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Weekly overview: who can see it

The weekly overview shows which check-ins were completed and the goals the member set for the week. Apart from the member, the overview is visible to the evening circle. Nobody else can see it. The member can end this access at any time from the sharing page.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Weekly overview: who can see it

The weekly overview shows which check-ins were completed and the goals the member set for the week. Apart from the member, the overview is visible to everyone the member invited during setup. Nobody else can see it. The member can end this access at any time from the sharing page.
